summary: Form labels and the Sign Up button unexpectedly shifted from start/left alignment to centered alignment, creating inconsistent alignment across the form.

regressions.explanation: The Username label text alignment changed from start to center within its 274px box, breaking standard left-aligned form label alignment.
The Password label text alignment changed from start to center within its 273px box, breaking standard left-aligned form label alignment.

The Sign Up button shifted from left-aligned (32px left gap, 412px right gap) to centered (222px gaps on both sides), misaligning it relative to the form labels centered at a different horizontal axis.
